description.fun: A lizard built like a motorbike, with a windscreen crest, indicator cheeks and a seat on its back. People have been riding Cyclizar since ancient times, as 10,000-year-old murals show, and it likes it too: the rider's body heat warms its back and lifts its spirits. Carrying a person, it can sprint at over 120 km/h. Koraidon and Miraidon are its relatives from the distant past and future.
description.guide: A Dragon and Normal-type lizard Pokémon from Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, used for riding since ancient times. The legendary Koraidon and Miraidon are its Paradox counterparts. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A motorbike lizard people have ridden for 10,000 years
